item.title: North Korea backs Russian, Belarusian vision for Eurasian ‘multipolarity’
item.description: North Korea joined Russia, Belarus, Iran and Myanmar in signing a joint statement on Tuesday pledging to develop a new security framework for the Eurasian region, formalizing Pyongyang’s role in a bloc of nations seeking to counter Western influence. item.title: Lee Sang-sin: Why most South Koreans no longer see unification as necessary
item.description: Lee Sang-sin of the Korea Institute for National Unification (KINU) returns to the podcast to discuss the results of the think tank’s annual survey, which found for the first time ever that less than half of South Korean adults think that unification with North Korea is necessary. item.description: A North Korean delegation of livestock experts visited a cattle operation in China in mid-January, the latest example of Pyongyang seeking to boost its agricultural sector using Chinese technology. item.description: Impoverished North Koreans who are unable to afford bribes face the harshest punishments if caught watching South Korean TV shows, according to testimonies collected by the nongovernmental organization Amnesty International. item.description: North Korea’s leading newspaper published two identical photographs in its Tuesday edition, in what appeared to be a rare editorial oversight.
